title: [observability] a queue heading stamped up to half an hour out of order across midnight is dated by its neighbours: an earlier heading more than 23 h 30 min earlier than the heading after it is the day after it, so 156's count of lead-mac's posts no longer depends on the hour it runs at
prompt:
Spawn, objective 195 [observability] (projects-47, 2026-11-15 03:1x: make 156.sh independent of the hour it runs at; rev-f found the reader at fault, and the lead approved this fix at 03:2x (with the bound at 23 h; 23 h 30 min here, for the reason below); reviewer rev-g): a queue heading stamped out of order across midnight is dated by its neighbours.

Line: [observability].

Why. 156 counts lead-mac's queue headings (`## <who> HH:MM — <text>`, no date) as the owner's interventions. scorecard/queue_posts.rs dates them back from the end of the file:
- the newest is on today's local date (yesterday when it is more than 5 minutes later than now);
- an earlier heading more than 12 h later than the heading after it is a day before it;
- anything else is the same day.
A heading stamped minutes before the one under it, across local midnight, is misdated: lead-mac's 00:10 above the lead's 23:50 reads 00:10 on 23:50's day, one day early, and every heading above it shifts too. The same main passed 156.sh at 17:49Z and failed on base and candidate at 19:1xZ (task 403's gate: "(1) expected total 5, got 2"; "(2) a day ending 2 days ago: expected 0, got 1"). A simulation of the reader over all 1440 minutes with 156.sh's headings (offset 480) fails in exactly local 03:00-03:19, when its out-of-order pair (the lead's post 3 h 20 ago under lead-mac's 3 h ago) straddles midnight. The live figure misdates the same way whenever a stamp is out of order across midnight.

What changes: crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/queue_posts.rs. Reading back, an earlier heading more than 23 h 30 min earlier than the heading after it is the day after it: a stamp up to half an hour out of order across midnight (BACK_ACROSS_MIDNIGHT_MINUTES). The approved draft said 23 h; at 23 h the existing unit test's same-day gap of 23 h 18 min (00:32, then 23:50) was read as the next day, so the bound is 23 h 30 min. Live's known skew is 20 minutes (rev-f F1). The 12 h wrap rule and the newest heading's rule stay. The price, said in the module doc: a gap of more than 23 h 30 min within one local day is read as the next day. That needs a silence of nearly a day starting right after midnight, against a stamp a few minutes off across midnight. Simulated on 20,000 random queues (gaps under 12 h, 20% of stamps up to 30 minutes late): 385 misdated, against 389 with today's rule (the same at 23 h and at 23 h 30 min). 156.sh's headings over all 1440 minutes: 0 misdated, against 20. A symmetric rule (the day after at more than 12 h earlier) was measured and rejected: 774, because it breaks quiet same-day gaps over 12 h.
Owner part: rsi/scenarios/195.sh (the contract). 156.sh is unchanged. When 195 lands, 156.sh comes off the quarantine list (the lead's next owner push).

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/queue_posts.rs; rsi/scenarios/195.sh (owner).
Size: queue_posts.rs +10 code (the rule, its constant and the module doc), +32 test (one new test), -2; 195.sh 361 (owner).

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/195.sh, black box: 156.sh's world and checks (1)-(6), with the queue's offset chosen at each run so that now is 03:10 in its local time. Its pair is then out of order across midnight at every run: the lead's post 3 h 20 ago reads 23:50, lead-mac's post 3 h ago above it reads 00:10.
On main 007563ed 195.sh exits 1 at (1): lead-mac's posts 3 h and 5 h ago are put a day early, out of the day's window (total 2, not 5).

Tests (unit): queue_posts a_stamp_out_of_order_across_midnight_is_the_day_after (new):
- an out-of-order pair across midnight (lead-mac's 00:10 above the lead's 23:55): 00:10 today, 22:00 above it yesterday;
- the line: 29 minutes out of order across midnight (00:14 above 23:45) is the day after; 31 minutes (00:16) is the 12 h rule's day, yesterday.
The existing lead_macs_posts_are_placed_by_the_midnight_wraps_and_counted_by_kind passes unchanged (its 23 h 18 min same-day gap included). No test is renamed or dropped.
